uxShell.adminEntryBody: This task needs Admin mode. Your existing city and permissions still apply.
uxShell.staffWelcome: Use Account → Admin mode to manage your city. Your personal Card is separate from staff card services.
uxShell.welcomeBody: Your digital Card is ready while your physical card is prepared. Show the live QR to crew; check-in is complete only after crew confirms it.
uxShell.loginBody: Enter your registered email. We will send a six-digit sign-in code to that email.
uxShell.registerBody: Registration opens in your browser. Return here and sign in with your registered email when finished.
uxShell.noMembership: This staff account has no personal membership
uxShell.noMembershipBody: Admin mode does not create a member profile, NIM or XP balance. Use Account for staff tools and contact your PATS crew about personal membership.
uxShell.qrPurpose: Show this live QR to crew. It refreshes automatically; a screenshot may expire. Displaying the code does not record attendance.
uxShell.physicalHint: Preparation status is separate from your digital check-in credential.
uxShell.cardHelpBody: Use your physical card at crew's NFC reader once received. Before delivery, or as a fallback, show the live app QR. For lost or damaged cards, ask crew for card support.
uxShell.IN_BATCH: Your physical card is being prepared
uxShell.physicalNext: Crew will confirm collection details when available. Your digital eligibility is checked separately.
uxShell.cardAccessibility: PATS member card for {name}. Favorite drink: {drink}. Quote: {quote}.
uxShell.noStaffEvent: No current event in this scope
uxShell.noStaffEventBody: Browse events to prepare the next event or review a past event.
uxShell.leaveBody: Leaving membership removes personal access. Review the confirmation carefully; attendance and transaction records are retained.
uxShell.queuesAllCities: Work queues across all authorized cities
